title: Tenant Geofence Policies, Retention Profiles, and Scheduled Evidence Exports
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Provide tenants a configurable geofence model for Hosted API routing, per-tenant retention profiles for request artifacts, and an automated evidence exporter that produces signed, time-bounded audit bundles suitable for compliance reviews.
proposed_solution: Define a Geofence policy object on tenant metadata: allowed_regions (array), enforcement (strict | prefer | log-only), and precedence rules (tenant > org > global).
Console UX: new Residency & Retention screen where tenant admins can create geofence rules, pick retention profiles (30/90/365/custom days) and schedule evidence exports (daily/weekly/monthly).
Public API: REST endpoints for reading and updating geofence and retention settings; endpoints guarded by RBAC and rate limits; API documented in API reference.

Routing changes: Smart Router attaches tenant_geofence to requests and attempts to route to nodes in allowed_regions. Strict enforcement rejects out-of-region nodes; prefer mode falls back but records trace. Router emits signed region assertions for each served request.

Evidence Exporter: background scheduler compiles signed routing traces, storage residency manifests, retention/deletion logs, and optionally hashed request metadata into a timestamped, signed archive for a requested interval. Support on-demand and scheduled exports.
Retention worker: applies TTL to persisted artifacts (logs, request caches) per tenant retention profile; deletion operations are recorded and included in evidence bundles.
acceptance_criteria: Console page implemented and tenant admin can set geofence and retention, enable/disable scheduled exports.
API endpoints available to read/write tenant policies with RBAC enforced; documented examples exist.
Router honors strict geofence: requests for strict tenants are only served by nodes in allowed_regions and include signed region assertions in traces.
Evidence Exporter can produce a signed archive for an arbitrary 7-day window containing routing traces, storage manifests, and deletion logs; archive downloadable from Console and via API.
Per-tenant compliance metric emitted (requests_in_allowed_region / total_requests) and shown in tenant dashboard.
Security signoff completed: signing keys managed via KMS, evidence archives are immutable and do not leak secrets.
Performance impact documented: median per-request P50 latency increase due to geofence enforcement < 10ms under normal load.
success_metrics: No critical residency-related incidents reported in first 90 days
>= 95% of pilot tenants confirm evidence bundles meet audit requirements
Compliance metric >= 99% for tenants using strict enforcement after ramping period
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal test with small set of tenants; validate router traces and signing; iterate on storage manifest format.
Beta: enable for selected enterprise customers behind feature flag; manual review of first 3 exports with compliance team.
Gradual: open to all tenants; enable default org-level policy UI; provide migration docs and export SLAs.
Fallback: if capacity is constrained in allowed regions, automatically switch tenant to 'prefer' mode with clear notification and include fallback events in evidence bundles.
open_questions: Canonical schema for storage residency manifest (fields and hash formats)?
Should evidence include truncated request payloads or only metadata+hashes to minimize sensitive data exposure?
How to express prioritized multi-region lists (example: prefer eu, allow us-west) — add weights or explicit ordering?
Billing model for scheduled evidence exports (free vs add-on) — product decision pending.
